title: Training at scale

captions.linkedin:
Quality should depend on the system, not on who's working that day.

My approach to training across locations: write the standard down, teach it with the same material in the same order everywhere, then check it.

A new hire's first month: before day one, explain the role, standards and tools. Day one, shadow a strong team member. First week, practice with real customers and get feedback. End of month one, review and refine.
